statement: TODO: replace this instruction with the reviewer's attestation citing the exact raw timestamp-proof SHA-256, contract effective/expiry evidence, bounded retrieval/private-storage authority, each approved public metadata category, and documented consent from the named timestamp verifier to publish that verifier identity and verification URI. For a finite expiry, set both post-expiry permission booleans true only when a separately retained clause authorizes continued private retention of the probe artifacts and continued public availability of the already-published aggregate receipt/metadata, and bind that clause with post_expiry_survival_evidence_sha256. Use contract_expiry_at=null only when the contract evidence affirmatively establishes no expiry and contract_has_no_expiry_confirmed is true; in that no-expiry case both post-expiry booleans must remain false and the post-expiry evidence hash must remain null. Raw or normalized market rows must remain non-redistributable.
